distribution.summary: Jilin; Liaoning; Inner Mongolia; Beijing; Hebei; Shaanxi; Sichuan; Taiwan; Chongqing; Heilongjiang; Shanxi; Shanghai
distribution.narrative: Yin et al. (1984) and Huang & Lu (2015) establish mainland records from Jilin, Liaoning, Inner Mongolia, Beijing, Hebei, Shaanxi, Sichuan. Beaver & Liu (2010) adds accepted Taiwan occurrence and reports broad China (CE, NE, NO, SW); the broad regional wording is retained as context and does not generate additional province records. Alonso-Zarazaga et al. (2023) list Chongqing, Heilongjiang, Shanxi, Shanghai as catalogue-reported mainland Chinese distribution for this taxon. These literature-based distribution records do not change the existing occurrence assessment.

host_note: The six species-level baseline hosts are retained. Beaver & Liu (2010) explicitly records Zelkova serrata as bred in Taiwan and also gives broader genus-level host context for Malus, Padus, Prunus, Pyrus, Ulmus, Zelkova and Lonicera; those genera are retained at their reported resolution.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Scolytus japonicus Chapuis, 1876.
